title: The Missing Kite
subtitle: An Afternoon Adventure in the Park
description: Follow Aarav and Meera on a sunny afternoon in the park as a strong gust of wind carries Aarav's red kite away.

segments.label: The Park
segments.description: It is a sunny afternoon in a neighborhood park. Aarav arrives with his red kite while Meera sits near the bench drawing.

segments.label: The Kite Flies
segments.description: Aarav runs into the wide open field, releases the kite into the breeze, and watches it soar into the sky.

segments.label: The Problem
segments.description: Suddenly, a strong wind gust pulls the string away from Aarav's hand, and the kite drifts behind a large bush.

segments.label: Finding It
segments.description: Aarav and Meera search the park, find the red kite behind the bush, and gently remove a stuck leaf.

segments.label: The Ending
segments.description: Returning to the field, Aarav holds the string firmly, and the red kite soars high into the sunny sky.
